description: Draws four Tarot de Marseille cards (Major Arcana) for one question and returns AskY's written reading of them: the cards, what each one says, how they read together, a piece of advice and a question to take away. Use when someone asks for a tarot reading about a question of their own. Pass only the question itself, not the conversation. Questions about a medical diagnosis, death, gambling, harming someone, or from someone in crisis are not read: the tool returns a supportive message or a gentler question instead of cards. The question is used only to write the reading and is then erased; the number of readings depends on what the person's account includes; when it is reached the tool says so. Requires the person to be signed in to their AskY account; the reading is saved to that account.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" for English, "es" for Spanish. Use the language the person is writing in. Defaults to English.

name.description: Optional first name to address the person by, only if they gave it.

question.description: The person's question, in their own words. One question, 3 to 1500 characters.

topic.description: What the question is about: love, work, health (health and wellbeing), friendship, or life (personal growth). Optional; leave out if unsure.

name: get_tarot_reading
title: Tarot reading
